ACTION BY WRITTEN CONSENT OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF THISTLEDOWN ROBOTICS, INC.

The undersigned, being all of the members of the Board of Directors of Thistledown Robotics, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the "Company"), acting by written consent without a meeting pursuant to Section 141(f) of the General Corporation Law of the State of Delaware and the Company's Bylaws, hereby adopt the following resolutions:

APPROVAL OF THE 2026 EQUITY INCENTIVE PLAN

RESOLVED, that the Thistledown Robotics, Inc. 2026 Equity Incentive Plan, in the form attached as Exhibit A (the "Plan"), is approved and adopted, effective as of March 1, 2026, subject to approval by the Company's stockholders within twelve months.

RESOLVED FURTHER, that 1,850,000 shares of the Company's Common Stock are reserved for issuance under the Plan.

RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Compensation Committee is designated as the administrator of the Plan.

APPOINTMENT OF OFFICER

RESOLVED, that Adaeze Mbanefo-Sørensen is appointed Chief Financial Officer of the Company, effective March 16, 2026, to serve at the pleasure of the Board.

GENERAL AUTHORITY

RESOLVED FURTHER, that the officers of the Company are authorized and directed to take all actions and execute all documents they deem necessary or advisable to carry out the intent of the foregoing resolutions, and that all actions previously taken by the officers in furtherance of these resolutions are ratified and approved.

This Written Consent may be executed in counterparts, each of which is an original, and shall be filed with the minutes of the proceedings of the Board of Directors. This Written Consent is effective as of February 24, 2026.

DIRECTORS:

/s/ Guillermo Salazar-Reyes
Guillermo Salazar-Reyes

/s/ Ingrid Halvorsen
Ingrid Halvorsen
